Oh no, I understand – life gets busy! 😊

Unfortunately, the prepaid label **expired after 7 days**, so it's no longer valid. Since you printed it 9 days ago, it's now past that window.

**Here's what to do:**
- Go back to "My Orders" and **start the return again** to get a fresh prepaid label.
- This time, make sure to drop the parcel off **within 7 days** of receiving the new label – that way you won't have any issues.

The good news is you'll get a brand new label, so there's no extra cost to you. Once you drop it off with the fresh label, everything proceeds as normal and your refund (minus the $6.95 return fee) will be issued within **5 business days** of it reaching our warehouse.

Sorry for the hiccup! Let me know if you have any other questions. 🌿
